name: Fjärdlång
description: Sparse-service Fjärdlång island loop from the public ferry quay. The route uses gravel road, narrow SAT-marked paths, technical coastal/cliff terrain, forest/ridge trail, meadows, bays and the island high point Tysta Klint. Current official SAT guidance says hikers must be self-sufficient: no water during 2026, limited services, and the hostel temporarily closed.
waterSources: SAT step guide says no water during 2026; hikers must bring their own. Do not promote hostel/cafe/camping/guest-harbor water claims unless a later current operator or official source confirms public drinking-water access.
notes: Route shape: counter-clockwise loop from Fjärdlång public ferry quay.
Fjärdlång research object is an isolated draft. Do not import automatically into app data.
Iteration 1 uses current SAT values 11.7 km, Moderate, 3.5 hours and 79 m elevation gain, while preserving official PDF/Outdooractive/export conflicts around 11.4 km and 4:00 h.
Current SAT guidance says no water during 2026 and hostel temporarily closed; this suppresses older service evidence for water, food, cafe, shop and lodging.
Dry toilets are the only normal facility candidates in iteration 1; all access, rules, emergency, lodging, rentals, harbors and boating services stay guarded metadata.

Iteration 2 proximity QA found Vedviken toilet candidates about 180-342 m from the official KML line, so Vedviken should be treated as an official side-facility/detour candidate rather than a directly on-route toilet.
Iteration 2 added coordinates for Tysta Klint and Thielska Villan, but kept swimming as a natural context anchored near Sopbryggan rather than an exact managed bathing facility.
Iteration 3 promotes Thielska Villan as a normal heritage POI candidate with a route-side spur caveat, and keeps swimming secondary because no exact managed bathing-place coordinate was found.
Iteration 3 import QA moved the southern tenting/camping area into pendingOnlyUntilVerifiedRecords so guarded campsite metadata is not mistaken for a normal facility candidate.

Iteration 4 added Noret/Långhuset as a route-side dry-toilet candidate for iteration 5 review, Klubbhamn/southwest as a weaker pending toilet candidate, and an additional Thielska/east-road toilet component.

Iteration 4 found USF/Vitsgarn public-service plans for summer 2026, but no current public hiker booking/opening/water terms strong enough to override SAT's no-water and bring-food/accommodation warnings.

Iteration 5 promotes Noret/Långhuset to a normal toilet candidate, keeps Klubbhamn/southwest pending-only, and preserves all water, hostel/cafe/kiosk/shop, campsite-service, rental, firepit, waste and boating suppressions.

facilities.name: Southern ferry/Sandviken/Thielska dry-toilet cluster
facilities.description: Cluster of dry toilets around the ferry/Sandviken/Thielska/campsite area. OSM has multiple access=yes or mapped pit-latrine toilets near the quay/reception/campsite; Länsstyrelsen and Explore confirm dry toilets on the island. Merge nearby toilet pins during integration and render at most one practical cluster marker unless the app supports de-cluttering.

facilities.name: Vedviken dry toilet
facilities.description: Official side-facility/toilet-cluster candidate matching SAT's Vedviken outhouse note. OSM has Skärgårdsstiftelsen-operated toilet buildings in the Vedviken/natural-harbor area, but mapped candidates sit about 180-342 m from the official KML route line. Do not imply this toilet is directly on the route line. If imported, render as an official Vedviken side toilet/detour facility or grouped side-service marker.

routeProximity.note: official side facility, but off the KML route line

facilities.name: Mörkviken dry-toilet cluster
facilities.description: Dry-toilet cluster on/southeast of Mörkviken, matching SAT's official outhouse note. The primary OSM node marks access=yes, fee=no, 24/7, Skärgårdsstiftelsen operator, pit latrine and no water. Use SAT/Harbourmaps spelling Mörkviken; keep Mörtviken as alias from OSM bay naming.

facilities.name: Noret/Långhuset dry toilet
facilities.description: Route-side dry-toilet candidate near Noret/Långhuset. Not SAT-named, but evidence is strong enough for normal review: Explore lists a dry toilet near this point, OSM node 2550378600 has access/operator/image/toilet tags, Wikimedia has 2025 geotagged public-toilet photos at the draft coordinate, Länsstyrelsen says dry toilets exist at several places on main Fjärdlång, and official KML proximity is about 4.7 m from the route. Promote as a normal toilet candidate, but preserve provenance that this is not SAT-named and was promoted through Explore/OSM/Wikimedia/Länsstyrelsen corroboration.

facilities.name: Thielska Villan
facilities.description: Official route landmark and Ernest Thiel's former summer house. It sits close to, but not directly on, the KML route line; keep as a route-side heritage POI rather than a facility or current service. Promote only as heritage/landmark POI. Do not treat as current accommodation, cafe, shop or service.

routeProximity.note: normal route-side heritage POI; about 70.6 m from official KML and about 100 m side branch per SAT step guide

facilities.name: Tysta Klint
facilities.description: Island high point/viewpoint included in the official full route. OSM/Mapcarta spell the mapped peak as Tystaklint; Länsstyrelsen uses Tyste klint; keep app display name as Tysta Klint with aliases.

facilities.name: Fjärdlång swimming cliffs and harbor beach context
facilities.description: SAT calls out swimming cliffs north of the garbage dock; Länsstyrelsen confirms bathing cliffs, and Visit Stockholm mentions rocks plus a small sandy beach by the harbor. The coordinate anchor is the garbage-dock/Sopbryggan reference point, not an exact swimming facility, and no exact mapped managed bathing place was found. Treat as natural swimming context with no services.
